usage: 中午 generally refers to the time when the sun is at its highest point, between morning and afternoon.
As a noun, 中午 can be used to indicate the time, especially around 12 o'clock.
In sentences, 中午 can be used to specify appointment times, such as telling someone to have lunch at noon.
The word '喺' can sometimes be added before 中午 to form '喺中午', meaning 'at noon', indicating the time when something happens.
Using 中午 to describe time is more colloquial; in more formal contexts, you might say 十二點正 (exactly twelve o’clock).
